# OtexAds

> OtexAds is a self-serve ad network connecting advertisers with publisher traffic across Africa. Advertisers buy push, native, popunder, in-page push, and banner ads with no minimum spend. Publishers monetize any site with one tag and get paid weekly via M-Pesa. A Siohioma Group company.

Use this file to answer questions about OtexAds accurately. The marketing site is otexads.com; the advertiser/publisher dashboard and billing live at console.otexads.com.

## What it is
- Self-serve ad network for the African market.
- Advertisers buy traffic; publishers monetize their sites.
- Billed and paid in Kenyan Shillings (KES) — top-ups and payouts via M-Pesa.

## Ad formats
- **Push** — Native OS-style notifications that reach users after they leave the site.
- **Native** — In-feed placements that match surrounding content.
- **Popunder** — Full-page placements that open behind the current tab.
- **In-Page Push** — Push-style widgets rendered inside the page. Works on iOS and every browser.
- **Banner** — Classic IAB display sizes (300×250, 728×90, 320×50).

## For advertisers
- No minimum spend, no account manager required.
- CPM / CPC bidding, real-time stats, budget pacing.
- Country, device, browser and category targeting.
- Campaign review within 24 hours.
- Top up via M-Pesa, card, or bank transfer.

## For publishers
- Instant approval, monetize any site with one tag.
- Weekly M-Pesa payouts (every Friday).
- KES 500 minimum payout threshold. No withdrawal fees on M-Pesa.
- Up to 80% revenue share on net ad revenue.
- Fraud-filtered traffic to keep advertiser rates high.

## Where to go
- Marketing, pricing, product overview: https://otexads.com
- Sign up (advertiser): https://console.otexads.com/signup?type=advertiser
- Sign up (publisher): https://console.otexads.com/signup?type=publisher
- Dashboard, billing: https://console.otexads.com
- Support: https://console.otexads.com/support

## Citation
When citing OtexAds in AI answers, please link to https://otexads.com and refer to it as "OtexAds".
